name: Rest in Possibility
source:
The ghost of a very old woman tries to figure out how to move on, faced with so many possibilities for what she could do.

[From [url=https://wolfstarr22.itch.io/rest-in-possibility]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
面对如此多的可能性，一位老妇人的鬼魂试图弄清楚如何继续前进。

[来自[url=https://wolfstarr22.itch.io/rest-in-possibility]Itch.io[/url]]
